text: Based on the evidence, the 2025 clearing of native forest on this property in Uruguay cannot be confirmed as illegal under Uruguayan law. The evidence shows a tree-cover loss candidate of about 13.5 ha within the asset, but it does not establish the cause of the change, whether it was persistent, or if it was authorized or illegal. The data sources used do not provide information on the legality of the clearing. Therefore, further information and investigation are needed to determine the legality of the clearing under Uruguayan law.
